notes: My Decks is now where you choose your deck: tap Rider–Waite–Smith, Tarot de Marseille, Thoth or one of your own decks to draw your readings with it. The home tile shows which deck you're using.
Your own decks have an Edit button. To add one, tap Add a new deck, name it, choose its kind, then tap Start photographing.
The bottom bar has a Settings button in place of Deck (Card by Card is still on the home screen). The More button and the ☰ menu now open Settings & Backup.
Settings → Arrange the home screen opens its own page, with a Home button and Revert to the original layout at the bottom. About & Credits is at the end of Settings.
